name: MyOS Session Subscription Ended
description: Response indicating that a root or linked-document subscription stream has ended. No further updates for this sourceInitialDocument are delivered under the identified subscription unless a future reinitiation protocol creates a new active stream.

sourceInitialDocument.description: Initial document identifying the ended root or linked-document stream.

reason.description: End reason, such as Requested, MandateTerminated, SourceUnavailable, Unlinked, or ProviderStopped.
